description: This file contains a conflict detection script for Font Awesome resources, including functions for MD5 hashing, DOM readiness, conflict reporting, and conflict detection logic for web fonts and SVGs within a web page.

methods.name: conflictDetection
methods.description: Main function to detect conflicts in Font Awesome resources, coordinating webfont and SVG conflict detection, and reporting results.

methods.name: detectWebfontConflicts
methods.description: Detects conflicts among web font resources by analyzing link and style tags, and runs diagnostic if conflicts are found.

methods.name: detectSvgConflicts
methods.description: Detects conflicts among SVG scripts by analyzing script tags and running diagnostics.

methods.name: setDoneResults
methods.description: Stores the results of conflict testing into the global FontAwesomeDetection object.

methods.name: pollUntil
methods.description: Utility function to poll until a condition is met or timeout occurs.

methods.name: md5ForNode
methods.description: Computes MD5 hash for a DOM node based on its src, href, or innerText.
